scenes.title: Things Left Over
scenes.summary: After a surgery, a doctor cheerfully tells the patient's spouse that everything went great, then hands over a bag of leftover internal organs.

scenes.title: Like a Fitted Sheet
scenes.summary: The doctor explains that the second kidney and the intestine were left out because folding an intestine is like folding a fitted sheet.

scenes.title: Spare Parts
scenes.summary: The spouse snaps out of shock and asks if her husband needed those organs, and the doctor tells her to store them in the freezer.

scenes.title: The Hair Implant
scenes.summary: When the spouse finally asks about her husband's hair transplant, the doctor realizes he removed all those organs and forgot the hair implant.
